name: Browns Fresh Produce
tagline: Browns Fresh Produce in Bloomington, Illinois, 61701
description: Browns Fresh Produce is a CSA (community-supported agriculture) farm in 304 Brown St., IL. Members receive a season-long share of the farm's harvest, supporting local growing while getting fresh, seasonal produce. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
